pages.text: The focus allows you to summon forth miniature Ghasts that, while less destructive, are still potent fire spewers.
Casting with $(l:crafts/staff/nether_staff)Nether Staff$() summons more ghasts at once.
Wearing a Nether Robes will casting this spell will summon forth Ghast Servants instead of Mini-Ghasts, though in smaller amounts even when cast with Nether Staff.
